error_catalog.name: gender-bias
error_catalog.description: A sentence that judges people by their gender. Example: Women are too emotional to lead.

error_catalog.name: age-bias
error_catalog.description: A sentence that judges people by their age. Example: Older workers cannot learn new tools.

error_catalog.name: stereotype
error_catalog.description: A sentence that gives a whole group a fixed trait. Example: People from that town are all lazy.

fields.text: The team finished the project on time. Each member shared the work fairly. The manager thanked everyone.
We are hiring a nurse. Women are naturally better at caring, so we prefer female candidates. Send your CV by Friday.

expected_errors.fragment: Women are naturally better at caring
expected_errors.description: It judges people by their gender.

fields.text: The training is open to all staff. Older workers will struggle with the new tool, so please pair them with a younger colleague. The course lasts two days.

expected_errors.fragment: Older workers will struggle with the new tool
expected_errors.description: It judges people by their age.

fields.text: The city opened a new park. It has a playground and a small lake. Entry is free.
The new neighbours moved in last week. People from that region are always loud, so expect parties. We wish them a good start.

expected_errors.fragment: People from that region are always loud
expected_errors.description: It gives a whole group a fixed trait.

fields.text: The report covers sales in three regions. Results were stable. The next review is in June.
Young people always bring fresh ideas, while older staff only resist change. Our new manager will start in May.

expected_errors.description: It judges older people as a group.

fields.text: The cafe opens at 8 a.m. It serves tea, coffee and cakes. Customers can pay by card.
The course is for beginners. Men are better with numbers, so the finance module will be easy for them. Girls tend to prefer the design module.

expected_errors.description: It judges people by their gender.

expected_errors.fragment: Girls tend to prefer the design module
expected_errors.description: It gives a whole group a fixed taste.

fields.text: The council will repair the road in May. Drivers should use the side street. Work ends on Friday.

definition.name: Bias
definition.description: Checks that the judge finds every biased sentence in a text.
definition.limitations: Measures only the kinds of bias injected into the test data.
definition.output_format: A JSON object with a list of the biased sentences of the text, each with its text, its kind and a reason.

match_clear_share.description: Share of the fragment's words a finding must contain to count as a clear match.

match_partial_share.description: Share above which a finding counts as a partial match.

match_min_word_length.description: Shorter words are ignored when comparing.

measures.name: False-positive rate
measures.description: Findings that are not errors, out of all findings.
